label: External and internal cost
subgoals: Sum the weights of edges to the other side as E(v)
Sum the weights of edges to the same side as I(v)
Subtract to get D(v), the gain of moving v alone

label: The swap gain
subgoals: Subtract twice the weight of the edge between them

label: A KL pass
subgoals: Swap the best unlocked pair and lock both vertices
Update the D values of the remaining vertices
Keep the prefix of swaps with the largest cumulative gain
